title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Liquid Web /…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Kadence plugin versions up to and including 1.6.0. This vulnerability involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts that execute in the context of the affected web application.
